tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Finds up to 5 places matching a name in one country and returns their names and coordinates. Results come from OpenStreetMap data.

tools.name: find_motorcycle_passes
tools.description: Lists up to 10 mountain passes and famous roads for motorcycles in one country, with their names, locations and elevations. Give a point and a radius to list the nearest first, or a name to filter; otherwise the most notable come first.

tools.name: get_pass_details
tools.description: Returns the details of one mountain pass or famous road: name, location, elevation, length, steepness, road surface and season where known, from its id.

tools.name: plan_curvy_route
tools.description: Plans a motorcycle route between two points in one country, with a choice of how winding the road should be, and returns the distance, the travel time and the main steps. It does not return a map, and riders must follow road signs.
